description: Access Yami helps users shop the largest Asian grocery & lifestyle store in North America directly inside ChatGPT. Users can take a Brand Taste Identity (BTI) quiz to discover their snack persona and get personalized picks, search and browse 10,000+ products by keyword, category, or brand, see trending best-sellers, link their Yami account, add items to their real Yami cart, and get a checkout link to complete purchase on yami.com.

defaultPrompt: Find me some popular Asian snacks
